title: Encryption and compression layers whose order decides what is stored

cases.says: Both stackings read back what was written, and the stored text is encrypt(compress(x)) for Compression(Encryption(store)) and compress(encrypt(x)) for Encryption(Compression(store)).
A character that is not repeated is stored alone: "abc" is stored as "abc".
Twelve a's are stored as "a12" and read back as twelve a's.
Writing "a2" or "7" through the compression layer throws IllegalArgumentException and stores nothing.
After the wrapped store is written directly with "y3", reading through the compression layer gives "yyy", not the last text written through it.
